# @tansy/theme-dispatch

A newsletter look: a masthead with the sign-up form, posts as numbered issues, an issue page made for reading, and the newsletter's own page for confirming and unsubscribing.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-dispatch
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the dispatch theme documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/themes/dispatch.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
